commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

88' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) sends a long through ball to Adama Boiro, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
88' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
87' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
82' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

81' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Johnny Cardoso is replaced by Marc Roca (Betis).
80' Today's match ends for Inigo Lekue who will be replaced by Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao).

79' Corner kick. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is ready to send the ball into the box.

78' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
78' The free kick is taken by Isco (Betis), but ball is cleared.
77' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

72' The game has come to an end for Sergi Altimira. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Vitor Roque (Betis).
71' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
69' 2 - 2 Alex Berenguer sends the resulting corner into the box and expertly finds Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the roof of the net. It's 2:2.
69' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
68' The resulting corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared by the defence.
67' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' The attendance is 49292.
64' Here's the change. Cedric Bakambu leaves the pitch and Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) comes on as a substitute.

63' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Adrian!
61' The referee is firm and issues Cedric Bakambu (Betis) a deserved yellow card.
59' Wasted effort! Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
57' It's a weak, uncertain finish and easy for the goalkeeper. Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) sends in a volley from just outside the box that goes a few yards wide of the left post.
56' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Mikel Jauregizar and he is replaced by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
56' A substitution has been made. Unai Gomez goes off and Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
55' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Adrian, who smothers the ball.
53' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Adrian with a brilliant diving save!
52' Handball by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Isco (Betis) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Angel Ortiz (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
48' Angel Ortiz (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Unai Simon intercepts the ball.

47' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Martinez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Betis are awarded a free kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Isco (Betis) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
45+3' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.

45+2' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Romain Perraud (Betis) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Unai Simon just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
45+1' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

43' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find Alex Berenguer, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
41' Juan Martinez blows his whistle. Antony (Betis) commits a foul after dangerous play.

40' Unai Simon was forced into action to thwart Johnny Cardoso (Betis). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
38' A pass by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

33' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
31' Isco slides a brilliant pass into Cedric Bakambu (Betis), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
29' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
29' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
28' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) picks out Alex Berenguer with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range. Ath Bilbao get a corner.
27' Juan Martinez blows his whistle and it's Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' Angel Ortiz (Betis) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

23' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
21' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
21' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
20' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Adrian.

19' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Inaki Williams was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
18' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
17' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

12' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
12' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
11' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Unai Simon has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
10' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
9' Antony (Betis) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
9' Isco (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Diego Llorente (Betis) plays a long ball to Cedric Bakambu, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
8' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick.
7' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
